posts.title: Redesign Kickoff: From Greeting Page to Digital Studio
posts.summary: A migration plan for turning this homepage into tools + content + blog + backend-managed platform.
posts.content:
## Why redesign now?
The current site has a memorable visual identity but all logic lives in one page.

## What changes first
1. Split routes for clearer information architecture.
2. Create shared services for content and tools.
3. Add an admin surface for fast updates.

## Success criteria
- New pages stay lightweight.
- Content is editable without touching core UI code.
- Backend integration is optional but easy to enable.

posts.title: Theme Engine Notes
posts.summary: Time-based themes keep the personal atmosphere but move into a reusable system module.
posts.content:
## Goal
Theme should not be a one-off script. It should be a shared capability.

## Theme dimensions
- Time period
- Palette
- Greeting tone
- Contrast mode

## Next step
Allow users to pin a preferred theme while keeping auto mode as default.

posts.title: Designing the Quick Admin
posts.summary: Fast data management starts local, then syncs to API when available.
posts.content:
## Product intent
Management should be fast enough for daily updates.

## Capability baseline
- Create, edit, and delete entries
- Search and filter
- Export data snapshots

## API contract
POST /posts
PUT /posts/:slug
DELETE /posts/:slug
GET /posts
